map.基于法拉第电解定律：电量 Q=电流 I×时间 t；理论沉积质量=电化当量 k×Q: Based on Faraday electrolysis law: charge Q=current I times time t; theoretical deposited mass = electrochemical equivalent k times Q (=k times I times t); times current efficiency gives actual deposited mass, for electroplating/electrolysis process design.
map.💡 法拉第定律：沉积质量 m = k×I×t×η/100（k 为电化当量 g/C: Tip: Faraday law: deposited mass m = k times I times t times eta/100 (k is electrochemical equivalent g/C, t in seconds); coating thickness delta = m/(rho times A) times 10^4 (um); consumed energy W = U times I times t/3600 (Wh).

map.算法：依据法拉第电解定律，电量 Q = 电流×时间（C）；理论沉积质量 = 电化: Algorithm: per Faraday electrolysis law, charge Q = current times time (C); theoretical mass = k times Q (g); actual mass = theoretical times current efficiency/100; coating thickness = actual mass/(density times area) times 10000 (um, area in cm2); deposition rate = actual mass/time (g/min); consumed energy = voltage times current times time/3600 (Wh); electrolysis power = voltage times current (W). Common equivalents: copper Cu2+ 0.0003294 g/C (density 8.96), silver Ag+ 0.0011180 (10.49), zinc Zn2+ 0.0003388 (7.14), nickel Ni2+ 0.0003042 (8.90).
map.例：铜镀液、2A、6V、30min、面积 50cm²、电流效率 95% → Q: Example: copper bath, 2 A, 6 V, 30 min, area 50 cm2, efficiency 95% -> Q 3600 C (1.000 Ah), theoretical 1.1858 g, actual 1.1265 g, thickness 25.15 um (0.0251 mm), deposit volume 0.1257 cm3, rate 0.0376 g/min, energy 6.00 Wh, power 12.0 W, avg thickness growth about 0.838 um/min. If nickel bath, 5 A, 6 V, 60 min, area 100 cm2, efficiency 90% -> Q 18000 C (5.000 Ah), theoretical 5.4756 g, actual 4.9280 g, thickness 55.37 um (0.0554 mm), energy 30.00 Wh, power 30.0 W.
map.「厚度增速」卡片的数值为什么偏大？: Why is the thickness-growth card value too large?
map.该卡片在换算时混用了 cm² 与 m²（用面积/10000 得 m² 后仍与 g: That card mixed cm2 and m2 in conversion (using area/10000 to get m2 but still multiplying by g/cm3), so the result is about 1000 times too large. The example card shows 838.21, while the actual avg growth is 25.15 um / 30 min approx 0.84 um/min. Convert by coating thickness / time yourself, or just use the 0.838 um/min given here.
map.电流效率为什么达不到 100%？: Why can current efficiency not reach 100%?
map.实际电解时部分电流消耗在副反应上，最常见的是析氢（酸性镀液）或析氧，此外还有低价: In real electrolysis part of the current is spent on side reactions, most commonly hydrogen evolution (acid baths) or oxygen evolution, plus intermediate low-valence ions and impurity reduction. Acid copper can reach 95% to 100%, chrome plating is often only 10% to 25% due to heavy hydrogen evolution, cyanide baths mostly 60% to 90%; use the actual process value.
